kimpuruṣas
(‘Is [it] a man?’)
------------------------------------------
Kimpuruṣas are a special type of demigods with a human head and the body of a horse mentioned in the Hindu mythological literature.
Kimpuruṣa is also the name of a king who was the son of आग्नीध्र, emperor of जम्बूद्वीप. His queen was Pṛthurūpā. He was ruling over a kingdom in the Himālayan region. अर्जुन collected money from him for the राजसूय sacrifice.
